name: Skylar Alston
strengths: Alston's listed 6-2 / 210 LB frame fits a modern WILL/MIKE second-level mold — length to chase and enough mass to take on climb blocks as he fills.
Alston ranks as a 4-star national board piece (Natl #176 · Pos #16 · NC #7) with a proven multi-school unofficial-visit trail across the SEC and ACC.
Alston already has Florida on the offer sheet with Ron Roberts attached — the Gators are on the board while South Carolina still leads the early RPM ladder.
weaknesses: Alston film package is not on file yet — coverage fluidity, blitz timing, and finish vs SEC climb blocks need a real Hudl pass before the Vault Scouting card hardens.
comparison: Alston comps to Ernest Jones — 6-2 compact LB mold; downhill trigger, play speed to chase, and enough frame to fill before packing full MIKE mass (size-matched within ~1–2"; not a Florida-alum default).
projection: Alston projects as develop into Florida's LB room with Year 1 special-teams / package snaps, Year 2 compete for a WILL/MIKE rotation role, with every-down starter upside if the 6-2 / 210 frame and board pedigree translate to SEC second-level fits.
schemeFit: Alston fits White's odd front as a WILL/space LB who can chase, fill, and grow into early-down run fits behind Graham/Robinson-type production.
